summary: The crowd boos the winner: In your concession speech, your supporters boo when you say {winner}'s name.
realLife: In his 2008 concession in Phoenix, some supporters booed when he said he had called Barack Obama, and at a mention of Joe Biden; applause rose when he praised the historic nature of Obama's win.
gates: A speech to your supporters that night.
choices: quiet them and say the name again
let it pass and go on

branches.then: The fireworks bought for it are never set off, and the empty lawn is the picture.
It is the record {winner}'s people read when you next need them.
